newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Volga-Dnepr adds giant An-124 freighter.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Volga-Dnepr adds giant An-124 freighter.

text.p: Russian private carrier Volga-Dnepr has added a seventh giant Antonov An-124-100 cargo aircraft to its fleet, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
Konstantin Rogov told Reuters by telephone from the central Russian city of Ulyanovsk that the four-engined jet, the world's biggest production cargo plane, was acquired from the Aviastar plant.
He did not say whether the plane, known as a "Ruslan", was bought or leased.
"We plan to increase our An-124-100 fleet's cargo operations," Rogov said.

These planes, which can carry up to 120 tonnes of freight, accounted for $59 million of the company's sales between January and August this year, which was 53 percent more than in the same period of 1995.
Volga-Dnepr also operates three Ilyushin-76TDs, one Antonov-12 and one Antonov-32. The company had sales of $87.2 million in 1995 compared with $87.8 million in 1994.
